evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Yet for multiple questions sharing the same visual input, autoregressive multimodal large language models generate answers token by token, accumulating sequential decoding costs as question count grows and delaying completion of the decision set.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ViDM, which transforms multi-question visual inference into parallel decisions in a single forward pass, improving both accuracy and inference efficiency.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across nine benchmarks spanning image, multi-image, and video tasks, ViDM improves Qwen3.5-4B's average accuracy from 73.49% to 77.55% while achieving 8.4x the baseline's average end-to-end throughput.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: On GQA, where each evaluated image has 11.4 questions on average, the end-to-end speedup reaches 20.3x.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: A Decision-Query Mask aligns each decision query's direct attention with shared context and its corresponding question, while case-balanced multi-order training strengthens robustness to question reordering.
